_readme: Site-wide identity for canonical URLs, Open Graph/Twitter tags and JSON-LD, injected at build time by src/seo.js. Update siteUrl if the deployment domain ever changes. The `app` block feeds /app (src/build-app.js): set storeUrl once the iOS app is on the App Store and the page switches from 'coming soon' to a download button.

app.comingSoon: Coming soon to the App Store
app.fineprint: Free. No account, no ads, no tracking.
